reason: v1 pooled individual Fourier-band cells without requiring within-cluster direction coherence. The raw-state v1 test failed; PCA6-only topology was insufficient. Use original paper-style rotational clusters with deterministic phenotype refinement, not PH-guided choice.
selection_data: ONLY original discovery ratemaps and their 360 SAC rotational correlations; validation/confirmation PH not used to choose clusters

eligible_rotation_clusters.band_majority: at least half members have v1-defined axial Fourier power concentration >=0.5

choice: largest union among all eligible triplets, tie break cluster-label lexicographic. Cluster IDs are discovered, not hard-coded; no topology values read.
condition_scope: report separately; stationary success cannot be relabeled as random-motion raw-state success
topology_rule: same raw Euclidean statistic, H0/H1/H2 fields 47 and 2, 384/512 farthest-point landmarks, median-distance filtration cutoff and effect-size thresholds as v1
p_value: plus-one empirical permutation test; zero nonnegative statistic implies p=1 and 19 diagnostic draws
multiple_testing: Holm across six source/method/condition slots per heldout split: v1 two sources; v2 two sources x two conditions. Unavailable candidates assigned p=1. Accept a condition only if BOTH fresh splits pass adjusted p<=0.05 and field/landmark sensitivity.
interpretation: torus-consistent raw subpopulation structure in tested condition, not all-neuron torus, not proof of mathematical homeomorphism, not proof of biological equivalence
fallback_if_no_v2_success: two newly initialized original-hyperparameter training seeds, report actual budgets; do not silently discard failures
